requirements.quote: `forgedock orchestrate 1 2` on Windows starts schedd and streams rows
schedd tests cover the win32 path selection
On `process.platform === "win32"`, derive the socket from the sched dir as a named pipe
for both `listen` and `createConnection`, and skip the stale-socket unlink for pipes.
Publish a release containing the `fileURLToPath` fix.
requirements.why: npm release publishing is a maintainer action outside the lane; the code fix (fileURLToPath in defaultSpawn) is delivered here as part of R6

deliverables.change: scheddPaths(dir, platform=process.platform): on win32 sock is \\.\pipe\forgedock-schedd-<sha1(resolve(dir)).slice(0,12)>; skip rmSync(p.sock) (startup and close) and the existsSync(p.sock) lost-socket watchdog on win32; scheddExists on win32 checks the lock file; defaultSpawn script default uses fileURLToPath(new URL(...)).

Add tests: scheddPaths(dir,'win32') returns a \\.\pipe\forgedock-schedd- name, stable per dir and distinct across dirs; linux/darwin keep join(dir,'schedd.sock'); defaultSpawn default script is a valid filesystem path (no leading '/C:').

preserve.what: POSIX behaviour: sock stays <dir>/schedd.sock, with stale-socket unlink and lost-socket watchdog (bin/lean/schedd.mjs:139,281,296; tests schedd.test.mjs:72,327,368,457,610)
scheddPaths return shape {dir,sock,lock,log} and connectDaemon/request signatures used by orchestrate (bin/lean/schedd.mjs:48,349,380)

decisions.choice: Keep helper inside schedd.mjs with no new module; hash the resolved sched dir so distinct HOME/dirs get distinct pipes
decisions.justification: Precedent: helpers stay in schedd.mjs next to batchEnv (#4734, PR #4743); tests already use per-test sched dirs (schedd.test.mjs:72)

decisions.choice: On win32 skip the existsSync lost-socket watchdog rather than probing the pipe
decisions.justification: Named pipes are not filesystem entries and vanish with their server; the lock-file watchdog (schedd.mjs:289-295) still covers takeover
